notFrozenText: Freeze the version on the contract card first.
signWillFreezeText: Press “Sign” — the version will be locked in and signed
aiSummaryDisclaimer: The AI summary doesn’t replace the full contract text — check it before signing.
paymentsFreeNote: The platform doesn’t charge a transfer fee
paymentsPaidNote: The operator’s fee is charged to the payer
freeCoreNote: The contract, signature, evidence, and reputation — no extra charges.
oneSignatureWaiting: One signature is in — waiting for the second
editWarning: You can only change the terms of an already-signed contract through an amendment
simulateVerification: Demo: simulate a government e-ID verification requirement
verificationGateText: Before signing, verify your identity through a government e-ID service.
officialTextSheetSubtitle: This is the version that gets signed. Your screen shows a translation for convenience.
officialTextFootnote: If the translation and the official text disagree, the official text (English) governs.
noRenderNotice: Translation into your language isn't available yet — showing the official text (English).
realNotReadyText: The contract must be sent for review and reach agreement before it can be frozen.
realNoSignatoryText: Signing from a business profile isn't supported yet (needs a power of attorney — in development). Only available from a person profile for now.
realClosedTitle: This contract is no longer being signed
realClosedText: Negotiation is closed: the contract was rejected or withdrawn. Details are on the contract card.
rejectConfirmText: The contract will move to rejected; signatures and requests of the current round will be annulled. This can’t be undone.
withdrawConfirmText: The contract will be marked withdrawn; signatures and requests of the current round will be annulled. This can’t be undone.
realVersionUnknown: The contract is frozen, but this session doesn’t know the version — reload the page.
